description: This file defines the SNPreferencesService class, which manages user preferences including loading, updating, and reloading preferences, and handles related events and synchronization.

classes.name: SNPreferencesService
classes.description: A service class for managing user preferences, including loading, updating, and event handling.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up observers and references when the service is deinitialized.

methods.name: handleApplicationStage
methods.description: Handles different application stages, particularly loading preferences after database is loaded.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a preference value by key, with optional default.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a preference value and triggers synchronization.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads preferences from storage if needed, and notifies if preferences have changed.
